action.new_text:
"""Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
    # Validation
    if not all(isinstance(x, np.ndarray) for x in [logp_with_result, logp_call_only, logp_no_call]):
        raise ValueError("Inputs must be numpy arrays")
    if any(x.ndim != 2 for x in [logp_with_result, logp_call_only, logp_no_call]):
        raise ValueError("Input matrices must be 2D")
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("Shapes of input matrices must match")
    if logp_with_result.size == 0:
        raise ValueError("Input matrices must not be empty")
    if not all(np.isfinite(x).all() for x in [logp_with_result, logp_call_only, logp_no_call]):
        raise ValueError("Input matrices must contain only finite values")
    if not all((x <= 0).all() for x in [logp_with_result, logp_call_only, logp_no_call]):
        raise ValueError("Input matrices must be nonpositive")
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite")
    if tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be nonnegative")
    # Compute normalized weights
    future_horizon = logp_with_result.shape[1]
    t = np.arange(future_horizon)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * t)
    sum_raw = raw_weights.sum()
    normalized_weights = raw_weights / sum_raw
    # Weighted sums
    weighted_with = logp_with_result @ normalized_weights
    weighted_call = logp_call_only @ normalized_weights
    weighted_no = logp_no_call @ normalized_weights
    # Margin and keep mask
    margin = weighted_with - np.maximum(weighted_no, weighted_call)
    keep = margin > tau_filter
    return keep, margin
